login.heading: Sign in to start your shift
login.subline: Repair help from your plant's own experts, in your language.
login.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN? Ask your supervisor to reset it.
login.invalidLogin: Wrong employee ID or PIN. Please try again.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Try again in a few minutes, or ask your supervisor to help.
login.networkError: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
login.webHeadline: Every fix your experts make, ready for the next shift.
login.webSub: Review repairs, answer escalations and keep your plant's know-how in one place.
login.technicianNote: Technician? Open Kaarigar on your phone and sign in with your employee ID and PIN.
login.roleNote: Role-based access · your plant's data stays in your workspace
login.wrongEmailPw: Wrong email or password. Please try again.
login.enterBoth: Enter your work email and password.

tech.scanQr: Point the camera at the QR sticker on the machine
tech.noMachines: No machines in your plant yet. Ask your supervisor to set them up.

manager.emptyBody: Nothing waiting yet. Approved repairs will show up here.

record.title: Record a repair
record.promptTitle: Speak in your own language. Say:
record.prompt1: What was wrong with the machine
record.prompt3: How you fixed it, step by step

errors.insecure: Recording needs a secure (https) link. Open the app from the tunnel link.
errors.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Use Chrome.
errors.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the microphone in the browser settings and try again.
errors.no_mic: No microphone found on this device.
errors.failed: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again.

record.keepTalking: Keep talking. Tap again when you're done.

note.title: Your note
note.notFound: This note doesn't exist or isn't yours.
note.canLeave: You can leave this screen. Your note will be ready in My notes.
note.approvedText: Other technicians can now find this repair when they ask.

check.title: AI check
check.intro: Check what we wrote down. Fix anything that's wrong, then send it to your supervisor.
check.safetyMissing: No safety step was mentioned. Add one if this job needs it.
check.toggleLocked: Send or undo your changes first
check.discardConfirm: Delete this note and its recording? This can't be undone.

fields.safetyPlaceholder: e.g. Lower the ram onto safety blocks first

sent.title: Sent
sent.next: Your supervisor will check it. Once approved, other technicians can find this repair.

errors.no_speech: We couldn't hear a repair note. Record again a little closer to the phone.
errors.too_short: The recording is too short. Describe the repair in a few sentences.
errors.too_long: The recording is too long. Keep it under 3 minutes.
errors.bad_audio: This recording couldn't be read. Please record again.
errors.stt_failed: Speech service is busy. Tap Try again in a minute.
errors.llm_failed: The AI helper is busy. Tap Try again in a minute.
errors.server_restarted: The server restarted while working on your note. Tap Try again.
errors.upload_failed: Couldn't send the recording. Check your connection and try again.
errors.storage_failed: Couldn't save the recording. Try again.
errors.audio_too_big: The recording is too large. Keep it under 3 minutes.
errors.unsupported_audio: This recording format isn't supported. Use Chrome.
errors.audio_empty: The recording is empty. Record again.
errors.not_allowed: Only experts and supervisors can record repairs.
errors.not_editable: This note can't be changed now.
errors.not_deletable: Notes sent to the supervisor can't be deleted.
errors.still_processing: Wait until the note has been processed.
errors.record_again: This note can't be fixed by retrying. Please record again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

review.title: Review queue
review.empty: Nothing waiting yet. Approved repairs will show up here.
review.reasonLabel: Why are you sending it back?
review.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The cause isn't clear. Please record again and say what you found.
review.ownRecord: You recorded this note, so another supervisor needs to review it.

errors.own_record: You can't review your own record.
errors.incomplete: Add at least the problem and the fix before approving.

review.needProblemAndFix: Add the problem and the fix to approve.
review.emptyFieldHint: Not stated by the expert. Add it if you know it.

reasons.cause: Cause is not clear. Please say what you found.
reasons.steps: Please say the repair steps in order.
reasons.safety: Please add the safety step you followed.
reasons.wrongMachine: This doesn't match the machine. Please check and record again.
